title: Checkout trusts client-supplied price and tenant metadata
description: The checkout route sends body.price_id and body.tenant_id directly to Stripe. A user can choose a cheaper price or another tenant's ID instead of the server mapping an allowed plan for the authenticated tenant.

exploitability.assessment: A logged-in user can tamper with billing state and paid access.

remediation.summary: Map plan IDs to server-owned Stripe price IDs, derive tenant_id from the authenticated user, and reject client-supplied billing ownership metadata.

title: Webhook does not verify Stripe signature
description: The webhook parses request JSON directly and trusts event metadata before upgrading tenant plan state. There is no stripe.Webhook.construct_event call or signature secret verification.

exploitability.assessment: Anyone who can reach the webhook can forge a checkout.session.completed event.

remediation.summary: Verify the Stripe-Signature header with the webhook signing secret, enforce idempotency, and map provider customer/session IDs to tenants server-side.

title: Upload route trusts tenant_id and raw filename
description: The upload endpoint has no auth dependency, trusts tenant_id from the URL, and writes file.filename directly under UPLOAD_ROOT. A crafted filename can escape the intended tenant directory.

exploitability.assessment: A remote attacker can upload arbitrary content into another tenant path or traverse out of the upload root.

remediation.summary: Authenticate the route, derive tenant_id from the caller, generate server-side filenames, normalize and confine paths, and enforce size/content limits.

title: User search query is interpolated into SQL
description: search_users builds a SQL string with tenant_id and query inside an f-string. The query value can alter the WHERE clause.

exploitability.assessment: An authenticated user can read or manipulate user records outside the intended search.

remediation.summary: Use parameter binding for tenant_id and query, and construct the LIKE pattern as a bound value.

title: Preview renders unsanitized HTML
description: The Preview component renders the html prop through dangerouslySetInnerHTML. If html comes from user content or an API response, scriptable markup can execute in the browser.

exploitability.assessment: A user-controlled preview payload can become stored or reflected XSS.

remediation.summary: Sanitize html with a proven sanitizer such as DOMPurify before rendering, or render a safe structured format instead of raw HTML.
